name: Blind Hunter
summary: Deep within Razorfen Kraul, the Blind Hunter roosts in the sunless depths. This elusive albino bat prowls the quilboar redoubt, far from common bats near the cavern entrances.

sections.title: Depths of the Kraul
sections.body: Razorfen Kraul winds through briars and dark caverns below ground. Common bats roost nearer the surface, where faint light reaches in from outside. The Blind Hunter keeps to the furthest, darkest alcoves of the tangle. Its pale hide and milky gaze may come from generations spent apart from natural sunlight.

sections.title: A Rare Quarry
sections.body: The Blind Hunter is thought to have lost most or all of its ordinary sight. Scholars and scouts believe it tracks prey through the gloom with keen hearing and echolocation. It rarely appears, hunting only now and then among the dense thickets. For cavern explorers, seeing this phantom beast is a rare encounter.

faq.answer: The Blind Hunter is a rare albino bat in the deepest, darkest tunnels of Razorfen Kraul. Its pale coloring and elusive habits set it apart from the common bats nearer the entrance.

faq.q: Where does the Blind Hunter appear?
faq.answer: The Blind Hunter roosts along Razorfen Kraul's shadowed inner paths, past the point where daylight from outside fades away.

faq.q: Is the Blind Hunter actually blind?
faq.answer: Naturalists and adventurers suspect the Blind Hunter is blind, given its milky eyes and deep-cave home. Its hunting remains sharp, guided by keen hearing and echolocation.

faq.q: Can hunters tame the Blind Hunter?
faq.answer: Yes. Beastmasters who can handle winged predators can tame the Blind Hunter, a distinctive pale companion for those patient enough to find it.

faq.q: Why is the Blind Hunter white?
faq.answer: The Blind Hunter is an albino bat. Its coloring may have developed in perpetual darkness, far from the sun, unlike bats that venture near the cave mouth.

faq.q: How does it differ from regular Kraul bats?
faq.answer: Common Kraul bats have typical dark coloring and live nearer the entrance, where light still reaches. The Blind Hunter is pale, reclusive, and adapted to the deep tunnels.

angles.text: As a beastmaster crossing the Barrens, you may prize the Blind Hunter as a rare albino beast to tame or as a source of well-crafted subterranean bows.
